text:
maria: Quick follow-up to the deployment-abstraction RFC — can we lock the API surface now?

dan: TLDR: prefer same inference API, extend via opt-in fields

lee: Agree. Data plane differences are huge, though (KV cache, local filesystem, KMS)

ashley: Product ask: clear guarantees for "pin to exact model" across hosted/dedicated/private

maria: Right. We need a contract that says "pinning" semantics are identical or documented deviance

dan: Proposal: single REST endpoint /v1/serve with header `X-Deployment=hosted|dedicated|private` or body field `deployment`

lee: header vs body debate: header keeps URL stable but SDKs + proxies sometimes strip custom headers

ashley: From UX, body param is easier — SDKs can default per-tenant. But headers make routing simpler

maria: Tradeoff: headers enable smart routing w/o changing payload; body field is more explicit and versionable

dan: Another concern: private deployments can't phone home for telemetry. So API must allow `telemetry=false` and service-level no-op hooks

lee: Also KMS/HSM: private needs key alias and crypto operations to happen locally. Add `kms_mode` enum in config

maria: Example config snippet:
```
{"deployment":"private","model_pin":"model-x@v2.1","routing_policy":"latency","kms_mode":"local","telemetry":false}
```

ashley: Need to define rollback/fallback contract: hosted can fallback to public model variant, private must not unless customer opted-in

dan: So fallback behavior becomes part of the deployment contract: `fallback_policy: allow_public | deny`

lee: Batching/caching semantics: private infra may have smaller batch windows. We should expose `batch_window_ms` and `max_batch_size` as hints

maria: We want one SDK. Plan: same API surface but runtime will validate deployment-specific constraints and return `warning` codes if optional features are rejected

ashley: Product wants explicit migration path: When we change contract, we roll v2 and allow v1 for N months, send tenant notifications

dan: Tests: add a lightweight "airgap" CI that runs inference without outbound network; validate KMS/local behavior

infra-bot: Filed: https://rwd/internal/issue/PLAT-4123 (RFC follow-up: deployment contract + schema)

deploy-bot: canary deployed schema-validator v0.3 to staging

maria: Action items: dan to draft header vs body decision doc, lee to enumerate private-only constraints, ashley to write migration comms

ashley: +1 on owners

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll sync in the next arch sync if doc has more than 3 contentious points :thumbsup:
